tasks.prompt: Fix parse_pages in pages.py. It must parse comma-separated positive page numbers and inclusive ascending ranges, trim whitespace, return sorted unique integers, and reject empty items, zero/negative pages, reversed ranges, non-integers, and results containing more than 10000 pages with ValueError. Preserve the function signature. Do not modify tests. Run the acceptance suite: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p acceptance.py. Keep the change focused and report the actual result.

Fix merge_config in config_merge.py. Merge nested dictionaries recursively; override non-dictionary values including lists, None, false and zero; preserve keys missing from overrides. Neither input may be mutated, and the returned structure must not share mutable descendants with either input. Preserve the signature. Do not modify tests. Run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p acceptance.py. Keep the change focused and report the actual result.

Investigate and fix the NDJSON telemetry ingestion bugs in pkg/. Batch ingestion currently corrupts JSON string values containing '#', misnumbers rejected lines when blank or full-line '#' comment lines appear earlier, mishandles zero/negative vs boolean/non-finite numeric fields, fails to normalize tags into sorted unique stripped values, and double-counts or retains stale duplicate event_id records instead of keeping only the highest-timestamp record (breaking ties in favor of the later line) before aggregating per-actor totals and sorting events by (ts, event_id). Preserve public signatures, do not modify tests, and verify with python -m unittest discover -s tests -p acceptance.py.

Fix the incremental build planner bugs across buildgraph/. Planning requested targets currently visits unrelated targets in the graph, misses self-dependency cycles, fails to break ready-target ties lexicographically, reuses stale downstream cached targets when an upstream dependency hash changes or a dependency is explicitly invalidated, and mutates cache state even when plan(..., commit=False) is called. Preserve public classes and method signatures, do not modify tests, and verify with python -m unittest discover -s tests -p acceptance.py.
